ex.E:
(1) Correct: an ideal gas has no intermolecular forces, so the molecules never stick together to form a liquid.
(2) Incorrect: the temperature stays the same, so the average KE of the molecules does not change. (Collisions with the walls do become less frequent because the volume is larger.)
(3) Correct: with no intermolecular forces there is no molecular PE, so internal energy = total KE of the molecules.
Hence (1) and (3) only → C.
ex.C:
(1) 正確：理想氣體分子之間沒有作用力，分子不會聚在一起成為液體。
(2) 不正確：温度不變，分子的平均動能不變。（體積增大，分子撞擊器壁的頻率確實會下降。）
(3) 正確：分子之間沒有作用力，即沒有分子勢能，內能 = 所有分子動能的總和。
故只有 (1) 和 (3) → C。

ex.E:
Take right as positive: u = +5 m s−1, a = −2 m s−2, so s = 5t − t2.
• 0 to 2.5 s: the car still moves right but slows down → s increases with a decreasing slope.
• At t = 2.5 s: v = 0, the s–t graph has a turning point (slope = 0, a smooth curve, no sharp corner).
• After 2.5 s: the car moves left and speeds up → s decreases with an increasingly negative slope.
A constant acceleration gives a parabola. The graph whose slope changes smoothly in this way is D.
ex.C:
取向右為正：u = +5 m s−1，a = −2 m s−2，故 s = 5t − t2。
• 0 至 2.5 s：汽車仍向右移動但減速 → s 上升，斜率逐漸變小。
• t = 2.5 s：v = 0，s–t 線圖出現轉向點（斜率為零，線圖平滑，沒有尖角）。
• 2.5 s 後：汽車向左加速 → s 下降，斜率越來越負。
恆加速度的 s–t 線圖是拋物線，斜率平滑地變化的是 D。

ex.E:
An action–reaction pair: (i) same type of force, (ii) equal in size, opposite in direction, (iii) acting on two different objects (A on B, and B on A).
A: weight (gravitational) and normal force are different types and both act on Peter ✗.
B: both act on Peter ✗.
C: rope on Peter and Peter on rope — same interaction, two objects ✓.
D: these act on two different people and come from the ground, not from each other ✗.
Answer C.
ex.C:
作用力與反作用力：(i) 屬同一類力；(ii) 大小相等、方向相反；(iii) 分別作用在兩個不同的物體上（A 對 B，B 對 A）。
A：重量（引力）與法向力屬不同類型，而且都作用在培傑身上 ✗。
B：兩力都作用在培傑身上 ✗。
C：繩對培傑的力與培傑對繩的力，是同一相互作用中兩物體間的一對力 ✓。
D：兩力分別來自地面、作用在兩個人身上，並非兩人之間的相互作用 ✗。
答案 C。

ex.E: Treat each arm of the L-shaped reflector as a plane mirror. The part of the pulse that hits the upper arm is reflected as if it came from the image of the source behind the upper arm, so it is still circular (curved) and moves away from the upper arm, downward to the right. Likewise the part hitting the lower arm moves upward to the right. The two reflected curved fronts start from the corner and spread outward → D.
ex.C: 把 L 形反射器的兩邊分別當作平面鏡。射向上邊的脈衝部分被反射後，就像來自上邊後方的像點，所以仍是圓弧形，並向右下方離開上邊；同理，射向下邊的部分向右上方離開。兩段反射的弧形波陣面由角落開始向外擴散 → D。

ex.E:
The angle between a wavefront and the boundary equals the angle between the direction of travel and the normal. So θ1 and θ2 act as the angles of incidence and refraction.
Snell's law for waves: sin θ1 / sin θ2 = v1 / v2 ⇒ v2 sin θ1 = v1 sin θ2 → A.
ex.C:
波陣面與分界線的夾角，等於傳播方向與法線的夾角，所以 θ1 和 θ2 相當於入射角和折射角。
波的折射定律：sin θ1 / sin θ2 = v1 / v2 ⇒ v2 sin θ1 = v1 sin θ2 → A。

ex.E:
Check both conditions in each scenario.
• Light must go from higher n to lower n. Oil → glass (1.47 → 1.5) fails this.
• The angle of incidence (measured from the normal) must exceed the critical angle θc = sin−1(n2/n1). For crystal → glass, θc = sin−1(1.5/2.15) ≈ 44°; for crystal → oil, θc ≈ 43°. Both are larger than the 40° angle of incidence, so no TIR.
• Diamond → oil: θc = sin−1(1.47/2.42) ≈ 37.4° < 40°, so TIR happens → D.
ex.C:
逐一檢查兩個條件：
• 光必須由折射率較高的介質射向較低的介質。油 → 玻璃（1.47 → 1.5）不符合。
• 入射角（與法線的夾角）必須大於臨界角 θc = sin−1(n2/n1)。晶體 → 玻璃：θc ≈ 44°；晶體 → 油：θc ≈ 43°，兩者都大於入射角 40°，不會全內反射。
• 鑽石 → 油：θc ≈ 37.4° < 40°，發生全內反射 → D。

ex.E: Useful reference values: threshold of hearing 0 dB, rustling leaves/whisper about 20–30 dB, normal conversation about 60 dB, vacuum cleaner about 70–80 dB, pain threshold about 120 dB. The best match is whisper 30 dB and vacuum cleaner 70 dB → D.
ex.C: 常見參考值：聽覺閾 0 dB，樹葉沙沙聲／耳語約 20–30 dB，正常談話約 60 dB，吸塵機約 70–80 dB，痛覺閾約 120 dB。最吻合的是耳語 30 dB、吸塵機 70 dB → D。

ex.E:
(1) Correct: by Lenz's law the solenoid opposes the motion of the magnet. The induced pole at the top attracts the receding magnet, which fixes the current direction through the resistor as X → Y.
(2) Incorrect: at the lowest point the magnet is momentarily at rest, so the rate of change of flux (and the current) is zero.
(3) Incorrect: electrical energy is dissipated as heat in the resistor, so the oscillation is damped and the amplitude decreases.
Answer: (1) only → A.
ex.C:
(1) 正確：根據楞次定律，螺線管會反抗磁鐵的運動；磁鐵離開時，頂部感生的磁極吸引磁鐵，由此定出流經電阻器的電流方向為 X → Y。
(2) 不正確：磁鐵在最低點時瞬間靜止，磁通量的變率為零，感生電流亦為零。
(3) 不正確：電能在電阻器中轉為熱能散失，振動受阻尼，振幅逐漸減小。
答案：只有 (1) → A。

ex.E:
All batteries and internal resistances are identical. The larger the external resistance Rext, the smaller the current, the smaller the voltage lost across the internal resistance, and so the larger the voltmeter reading (V = ε − Ir).
External resistance: circuit 1 = 2R, circuit 2 = R/2, circuit 3 = 3R/2, circuit 4 = R.
So V2 < V4 < V3 < V1 → B.
ex.C:
各電池及內阻相同。外電阻 R外 越大，電流越小，內阻上的電壓損失越小，伏特計讀數（V = ε − Ir）越大。
外電阻：電路 1 = 2R，電路 2 = R/2，電路 3 = 3R/2，電路 4 = R。
故 V2 < V4 < V3 < V1 → B。

ex.E:
Track (A, Z): Po-216 is (216, 84). α: A − 4, Z − 2 → R = (212, 82). β: Z + 1 → S = (212, 83). β → T = (212, 84). α → U = (208, 82).
(1) R and U both have Z = 82, so they are isotopes ✓.
(2) Neutrons: Po-216 has 216 − 84 = 132 and U has 208 − 82 = 126, which is 6 fewer ✓.
(3) S → β → (212, 84) → α → (208, 82) = U ✓.
Answer D.

(1) Retrograde motion of Mars can be explained by both models (the geocentric model uses epicycles), so it does not specially support the heliocentric model.
(2) Galileo saw moons orbiting Jupiter: not everything orbits the Earth.
(3) Venus shows a full set of phases, which only works if Venus orbits the Sun.
Answer: (2) and (3) only → C.
ex.C:
(1) 火星逆行可以用兩個模型解釋（地心說用本輪），並非特別支持日心說。
(2) 伽利略觀察到衞星環繞木星運行，說明並非所有天體都環繞地球。
(3) 金星呈現完整的位相變化，只有金星環繞太陽運行才能解釋。
答案：只有 (2) 和 (3) → C。

ex.E:
Luminosity depends on the absolute magnitude M: the smaller (more negative) M is, the more luminous the star. Deneb (M = −8.38) is the most luminous.
Distance: m − M = 5 log(d/10 pc). The more negative m − M is, the closer the star. Sirius A: m − M = −1.44 − 1.42 = −2.86, the most negative, so it is the closest.
Answer A.
ex.C:
光度由絕對星等 M 決定：M 越小（越負），光度越大。天津四（M = −8.38）光度最大。
距離：m − M = 5 log(d/10 pc)，m − M 越負，恆星越近。天狼星A：m − M = −1.44 − 1.42 = −2.86，最負，所以最近。
答案 A。

ex.E: Dark dips in a star's continuous spectrum are absorption lines from elements in its outer atmosphere. Compare the wavelengths of the dips with each element's lab spectrum: the dips line up only with the hydrogen lines (e.g. about 410, 434, 486 and 656 nm). Helium, carbon and oxygen lines have no matching dips. → A.
ex.C: 恆星連續光譜上的暗陷，是其外層大氣中元素造成的吸收線。把暗陷的波長與各元素的實驗室譜線比較：只與氫的譜線（約 410、434、486、656 nm）吻合，氦、碳、氧的譜線都沒有對應的暗陷 → A。

ex.E: Rutherford's α-scattering showed that (i) most α particles pass straight through, so an atom is mostly empty space; (ii) a few are deflected through large angles, so there is a tiny, dense, positive nucleus holding most of the mass; and so the electrons must be outside the nucleus. Neutrons are neutral and do not affect the α particles. They were discovered later (Chadwick, 1932). → D.
ex.C: 盧瑟福 α 粒子散射實驗顯示：(i) 大部分 α 粒子直穿，原子大部分是空的；(ii) 少數大角度偏折，原子中心有一個體積極小、密度極高、帶正電的原子核，集中了大部分質量；故電子位於原子核外。中子不帶電，不影響 α 粒子，要到 1932 年才由查德威克發現 → D。

ex.E:
(1) Using the Coulomb force as the centripetal force is classical physics ✗.
(2) Classically an accelerating (orbiting) charge radiates EM waves, loses energy and spirals into the nucleus. Bohr postulated stable orbits with no radiation, which violates classical physics ✓.
(3) A negative total energy just means a bound (attractive) system, which is also true classically ✗.
Answer: (2) only → A.
ex.C:
(1) 以靜電力作向心力，屬經典物理 ✗。
(2) 根據經典物理，作圓周運動的加速電荷會輻射電磁波、損失能量並墜向原子核；玻爾假設電子在穩定軌道上不輻射，違反經典物理 ✓。
(3) 總能量為負只表示系統受束縛（吸引），在經典物理中亦成立 ✗。
答案：只有 (2) → A。

ex.E:
Below the threshold frequency f0 there is no photocurrent, so I = 0 for f < f0.
Above f0: the light power P = Nhf is fixed, so the number of photons per second N = P/(hf) ∝ 1/f. The maximum (saturation) current I ∝ N ∝ 1/f, so I jumps up at f0 and then decreases as f increases → D.
ex.C:
頻率低於臨閾頻率 f0 時沒有光電流，故 f < f0 時 I = 0。
高於 f0：光功率 P = Nhf 固定，每秒光子數 N = P/(hf) ∝ 1/f；最大（飽和）電流 I ∝ N ∝ 1/f，故 I 在 f0 處開始出現，隨後隨 f 增大而減小 → D。

ex.E: Electrons are charged, so a magnetic field (produced by coils, called magnetic lenses) can bend their paths and bring them to a focus, just as glass lenses focus light. A high voltage only accelerates them (shortening λ), and option D describes an STM. → C.
ex.C: 電子帶電，可利用線圈產生的磁場（磁透鏡）使其路徑偏折而聚焦，好像玻璃透鏡使光聚焦一樣。高電壓只用於加速電子（使 λ 變短），選項 D 描述的是掃描隧穿顯微鏡 → C。

ex.E: Catalysis happens at the surface. Breaking the metal into nanoparticles greatly increases the surface-area-to-volume ratio, so more metal atoms are exposed for reactions. This makes the converter more effective with less precious metal → A.
ex.C: 催化反應在表面進行。把金屬製成納米顆粒，表面面積對體積之比大大增加，更多金屬原子暴露出來參與反應，用較少貴金屬便得到更好的效果 → A。

ex.E: Rayleigh criterion: the minimum angular separation θ ≈ 1.22λ/d, where d is the pupil diameter. In daylight the pupil becomes smaller (d ↓), so θmin increases, which makes the resolution worse. The angle subtended by the bulbs (≈ dbulbs/s) must be at least θmin, so the bulbs must be moved further apart (or Peter must move closer) → D.
ex.C: 瑞利判據：最小可分辨角 θ ≈ 1.22λ/d（d 為瞳孔直徑）。日光下瞳孔變小（d ↓），θmin 增大，分辨能力變差。燈泡所張的角（≈ 燈距/s）必須不小於 θmin，故要把燈泡分得更開（或走近一點）→ D。

ex.E: Damage to the eardrum or the ear bones (the conductive path) reduces the transmission of sound at all frequencies. The whole threshold curve is shifted upward while keeping roughly its normal shape. Andrew's curve (A) is raised by about 60 dB across the whole range → A. (A dip or peak only near certain frequencies, such as around 4 kHz, suggests damage to the inner ear instead.)
ex.C: 耳膜或聽小骨（傳導部分）受損，會令所有頻率的聲音傳導都減弱，整條聽覺閾曲線上移，但形狀大致不變。安德魯（A）的曲線在整個頻率範圍上移約 60 dB → A。（只在某些頻率附近出現突變，例如約 4 kHz，較可能是內耳受損。）

ex.E:
Heat capacity C = Q/ΔT is the energy needed to raise the temperature of the whole body by 1 °C; it is proportional to mass (C = mc).
A: that describes specific heat capacity ✗. B: a bucket of water has a larger mass, so a larger C ✓. C: if C is the same, the energy per °C is the same whatever the material ✗. D: 4200 J kg−1 °C−1 is the specific heat capacity of water (per kg), not its heat capacity ✗.
Answer B.
ex.C:
熱容量 C = Q/ΔT，是使整個物體温度升高 1 °C 所需的能量，與質量成正比（C = mc）。
A：那是比熱容量的定義 ✗。B：一桶水質量較大，熱容量較大 ✓。C：熱容量相同，每升高 1 °C 所需能量就相同，與物料無關 ✗。D：4200 J kg−1 °C−1 是水的比熱容量（每 kg），並非熱容量 ✗。
答案 B。

ex.E:
For a fixed volume, pV = nRT ⇒ p = (nR/V)·TK, so the slope of the p–T graph is proportional to n.
(1) Gas X has the steeper line, so it has more moles ✓.
(2) Mass = n × molar mass. The molar masses are unknown, so the masses cannot be compared ✗.
(3) At the same temperature the average KE per molecule is the same, but crms = √(3kT/m) also depends on the molecular mass, which is unknown ✗.
Answer: (1) only → A.
ex.C:
體積固定時，pV = nRT ⇒ p = (nR/V)·TK，p–T 線圖的斜率與 n 成正比。
(1) 氣體 X 的斜率較大，摩爾數較多 ✓。
(2) 質量 = n × 摩爾質量，摩爾質量未知，無法比較 ✗。
(3) 同一温度下分子的平均動能相同，但 crms = √(3kT/m) 亦取決於分子質量，而分子質量未知 ✗。
答案：只有 (1) → A。

ex.E: Friction is constant and opposes the motion, so the block decelerates uniformly: the s–t graph rises with a gradually decreasing slope (a curve bending down). Once the block stops, friction does not push it back, so s stays constant and the graph becomes a horizontal line. The only graph that curves and then levels off is C.
ex.C: 摩擦力恆定並阻礙運動，金屬塊作勻減速：s–t 線圖上升而斜率逐漸變小（向下彎）。金屬塊停下後，摩擦力不會把它推回，s 保持不變，線圖變成水平線。先彎曲後變平的線圖是 C。

ex.E:
(1) Normal force on the person by the ground and the weight of the person act on the same body and are different types of force, so they are not a pair (they only balance) ✗.
(2) Rope on block and block on rope: same contact interaction between two bodies ✓.
(3) Air resistance and gravity both act on the raindrop ✗.
Answer: (2) only → A.
ex.C:
(1) 地面對人的法向力和人的重量作用在同一物體上，而且屬不同類型的力，只是互相平衡，不是作用與反作用 ✗。
(2) 繩對方塊的拉力和方塊對繩的力：兩物體之間同一接觸作用的一對力 ✓。
(3) 空氣阻力和重力都作用在雨點上 ✗。
答案：只有 (2) → A。

ex.E:
(1) F = mg tan 30° = 28.3 N, not 24.5 N ✗. (2) F = mg tan 30° depends on m ✗.
(3) Vertically T cos 30° = mg; horizontally T sin 30° = F, so T = √(F2 + (mg)2). If F increases, T increases ✓.
Answer: (3) only → B.
ex.C:
(1) F = mg tan 30° = 28.3 N，不是 24.5 N ✗。(2) F = mg tan 30°，與 m 有關 ✗。
(3) 鉛垂方向 T cos 30° = mg，水平方向 T sin 30° = F，故 T = √(F2 + (mg)2)。F 增大，T 隨之增大 ✓。
答案：只有 (3) → B。

ex.E:
(1) Thrown upward, the ball first rises and then falls from a greater height, so the time of flight is longer ✗.
(2) Energy conservation: ½mvland2 = ½mu2 + mgh. With the same initial speed u and the same drop height h, the landing speed is the same ✓.
(3) The horizontal velocity component (u cos θ) and the time of flight both change, so the range changes ✗.
Answer: (2) only → B.
ex.C:
(1) 斜向上拋出時，鉛球先上升再下落，飛行時間較長 ✗。
(2) 能量守恆：½mv落地2 = ½mu2 + mgh。初速率 u 與下落高度 h 相同，落地速率相同 ✓。
(3) 水平速度分量（u cos θ）和飛行時間都改變，水平距離改變 ✗。
答案：只有 (2) → B。

ex.E: The ray enters normally, so it is not bent at the first face. It then meets the slanted face with an angle of incidence of 45°. The critical angle is θc = sin−1(1/1.35) = 47.8°. Since 45° < 47.8°, total internal reflection does not occur. The ray refracts out into the air, bending away from the normal (angle of refraction = sin−1(1.35 sin 45°) ≈ 73°), with a weak partially reflected ray → D.
ex.C: 光線垂直射入，在第一個面不會偏折；到達斜面時入射角為 45°。臨界角 θc = sin−1(1/1.35) = 47.8°。由於 45° < 47.8°，不會發生全內反射。光線折射進入空氣並偏離法線（折射角 = sin−1(1.35 sin 45°) ≈ 73°），另有較弱的部分反射光 → D。

ex.E:
Separation = 12 cm = 4λ.
(1) On a nodal line the path difference is a half-integer multiple of λ, i.e. (n + ½)λ, not nλ ✗.
(2) Antinodal lines have path difference nλ with |nλ| < 12 cm, so n = −3 … +3, giving 7 antinodal lines between the sources, not 8 ✗.
(3) Along S1S2 a stationary wave forms. Adjacent antinodes are λ/2 apart, so the central antinode and the next node are λ/4 apart ✓.
Answer: (3) only → A.
ex.C:
兩波源相距 12 cm = 4λ。
(1) 節線上各點的程差是 λ 的半整數倍，即 (n + ½)λ，不是 nλ ✗。
(2) 腹線上程差 = nλ，且 |nλ| < 12 cm，故 n = −3 … +3，兩波源之間共有 7 條腹線，不是 8 條 ✗。
(3) 在 S1S2 連線上形成駐波，相鄰波腹相距 λ/2，中央波腹與相鄰波節相距 λ/4 ✓。
答案：只有 (3) → A。

ex.E:
Fringe separation Δy = λD/a. Moving the screen further away increases D.
(1) The same light energy is spread over a larger area, so each fringe is dimmer ✓.
(2) Δy increases, not decreases ✗.
(3) The fringes are more widely spaced, so fewer of them fit on a screen of finite size ✓.
Answer: (1) and (3) only → C.
ex.C:
條紋間距 Δy = λD/a，屏幕移遠即 D 增大。
(1) 同樣的光能分佈在較大的面積上，每條亮紋變暗 ✓。
(2) Δy 增大，不是減小 ✗。
(3) 條紋間距增大，有限大小的屏幕上可見的亮紋數目減少 ✓。
答案：只有 (1) 和 (3) → C。

ex.E:
(1) Reflection does not change the frequency ✓.
(2) Some energy is absorbed by the walls and the sound spreads out, so the echo has a smaller amplitude ✓.
(3) The echo travels in the same air at the same speed. Since λ = v/f and both are unchanged, λ is unchanged ✗.
Answer: (1) and (2) only → A.
ex.C:
(1) 反射不會改變頻率 ✓。
(2) 部分能量被牆壁吸收，聲音亦向外擴散，回聲振幅較小 ✓。
(3) 回聲在同一空氣中傳播，速率不變；λ = v/f，v 和 f 不變，λ 亦不變 ✗。
答案：只有 (1) 和 (2) → A。

ex.E:

ex.E: An STM does not use an electron beam or lenses. A change in height of a fraction of an atom changes the current a lot, so atomic-scale bumps can be mapped → C.

ex.E: In an LED, electrons cross the p–n junction and recombine with holes. Each electron drops from the conduction band (higher energy) to the valence band (lower energy) and the energy difference is emitted as a photon. This is direct conversion of electrical energy to light, not fluorescence, re-emission or friction → D.
ex.C: LED 中，電子越過 p–n 結與空穴復合，由導帶（較高能量）落到價帶（較低能量），能量差以光子形式釋出。這是電能直接轉為光能，並非熒光、吸收後再發射或摩擦生光 → D。
